sar.narrative: Who: the subject is customer C13487, holder of card C13487-K1, together with 19 other card(s) (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, and others) that used the same device profile. What: 26 transaction(s) totalling $3,778.14 across 20 card(s) were identified as one suspected fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3457285. When: the activity ran from 2016-11-14 to 2016-11-22, and the transaction under review occurred on 2016-11-22. Where: the activity was online, with the reviewed transaction billed in billing region 191 and using device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 (D_2c2006f554). How: one device profile was shared by 44 customers, 100% of its transactions carried a new-device marker and 100% came through an anonymising proxy, which is how the linked cards were found. Why suspicious: the pattern matches no documented fraud type but shows coordinated use of one device across many customers (policy R9); several cards are tied to one device profile (policy R6); the total exceeds $1,000. Recommended next actions (recommendations only, none executed): CREATE_CASE, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, MONITOR_CARD, DECLINE_TRANSACTION.
